Change c0011. Location: 1818 Letter I; 1831 Letter I.

Context before (unchanged): These visions faded when I perused, for the first time, those poets whose effusions entranced my soul, and lifted it to heaven.

1818 text: I also became a poet, and for one year lived in a Paradise of my own creation; I imagined that I also might obtain a niche in the temple where the names of Homer and Shakespeare are consecrated.

1831 text: I also became a poet, and for one year lived in a Paradise of my own creation; I imagined that I also might obtain a niche in the temple where the names of Homer and Shakspeare are consecrated.

Diff: I also became a poet, and for one year lived in a Paradise of my own creation; I imagined that I also might obtain a niche in the temple where the names of Homer and [-Shakespeare-] {+Shakspeare+} are consecrated.

Context after (unchanged): You are well acquainted with my failure, and how heavily I bore the disappointment.

result.rationale: Only the orthography of Shakespeare changes to the archaic Shakspeare; the wording, meaning, and reference to the poet are unchanged.
